
⏺ Now I can see the mechanism, and the likely cause. Codex
  built AnswerForm, which submits by arithmetic:

  moveFocus(ctx, name, safeMove)     // step to a known
  position
  for _, key := range toggleKeys { sendLiteral(...) }
  moveFocus(ctx, name, targetMove)   // step to the submit
  control
  run(ctx, "send-keys", name, "Enter")

  If targetMove is off by even one, Enter lands on option 1 and
  toggles it — exactly what you saw. And it's computing those
  offsets blind: I never captured a multi-select or preview
  frame, so there's no ground truth for either layout. That's
  the real gap.
